points.description: Abstraction (or data abstraction / implementation hiding expressed as abstraction) is stated as an advantage of object-oriented programming. Equivalent Tamil or English wording is accepted.
Reusability (code reuse / reuse of classes or objects) is stated as an advantage of object-oriented programming. Equivalent Tamil or English wording is accepted.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both advantages named in the model answer: abstraction and reusability. A student who gives only one of these earns the marks for that point only (2.5). Other OOP features or advantages not in the model answer do not earn these marks.
